Physical hypothesis: on real hardware/driver UNINITIALIZED need not mean missing driver and would be misreported as NOT_CHECKED instead of attempted-failure FAIL.

findings.exact_source: static void lzq_int(LzqW& w,int v){ if(v<0){lzq_ch(w,'-'); lzq_u64(w,uint64_t(-v));} else lzq_u64(w,uint64_t(v)); }
findings.minimal_fix: Convert via int64_t or unsigned arithmetic that is safe for INT_MIN, e.g. int64_t t=v; if(t<0){ch('-'); u64(-(t+1)+1);} before emitting.
findings.reason: Static fact: -v on int with v==INT_MIN is signed-overflow UB. Stub observation: only small values -1/indices are emitted in measured cases, so UB never triggers. Physical hypothesis: future error/index values hitting INT_MIN would be undefined behavior in collector output path, independent of hardware.

findings.minimal_fix: Guarantee physical-root directed coverage independent of subdevice order: select P2P set by roots first (or document enumerated-window semantics and add p2p window indices), and add a stub case where subdevices fill the first 16 slots.

findings.exact_source: static void lzq_esc(LzqW& w,const char* s){ lzq_ch(w,0x22); for(const unsigned char* p=(const unsigned char*)s;*p;++p){ unsigned char c=*p; if(c==0x22){lzq_ch(w,0x5c);lzq_ch(w,0x22);} else if(c==0x5c){lzq_ch(w,0x5c);lzq_ch(w,0x5c);} else if(c<0x20){lzq_ch(w,' ');} else lzq_ch(w,char(c)); } lzq_ch(w,0x22); }
findings.minimal_fix: Document lossy control-character mapping and add a device-name case with quotes, backslash, controls and max-length name asserting strict-JSON validity and truncation behavior; consider documented escaping rather than space substitution if fidelity matters.
findings.reason: Static fact: esc produces valid JSON by replacing bytes below 0x20 with space and copying other bytes raw. Stub observation: stub names are simple SYNTHETIC Intel root strings, so escaping edge paths are unmeasured. Physical hypothesis: real device names with controls, quotes, backslash, non-ASCII or full 256-char names could lose fidelity or interact with output truncation while tests still report PASS.
